world.title: Imran Khan offered 'deal' by Shehbaz govt to secure release from prison? Ex-Pak PM's son drops hint
world.summary: Kasim Khan, son of former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan, expressed a desire for his father to accept a deal from the government to secure his release from prison. He stated that he finds it challenging to envision seeing his father again and is willing to do anything necessary to facilitate his release from incarceration.

world.title: Watch: Government building collapses into river as heavy rains trigger fresh landslide in Nepal
world.summary: A government ward office building in Nepal's Baglung district collapsed into the Daram River following a landslide caused by prolonged heavy rainfall. The incident was captured on video, showing a section of the hillside giving way. Authorities are assessing the damage and potential risks in the area as weather conditions remain unstable, prompting concerns for public safety.

world.title: Video: Screams Heard As Part Of Nepal Mountain Crumbles Into River In Seconds
world.summary: Recent floods and landslides in Nepal have resulted in at least 24 fatalities and 14 individuals reported missing across multiple districts. Videos show a mountainside collapsing into a river, capturing the distress of onlookers. The incidents highlight the severe impact of natural disasters in the region, prompting concerns about safety and emergency response efforts in affected areas.

business.title: 2026 Renault Triber Turbo Launched At Rs 7.84 Lakh: More Performance From A Small 7-seater!
business.summary: The 2026 Renault Triber has been launched at a price of Rs 7.84 lakh, featuring a new turbo-petrol engine shared with the Kiger compact SUV. Known for its family-friendly design, the Triber offers a flexible cabin and a 7-seater layout, along with modern features, addressing previous performance concerns while maintaining affordability.

business.title: Nvidia boosts share buyback by record $150 billion as AI boom fuels growth
business.summary: Nvidia has increased its share buyback authorization by a record $150 billion, surpassing Apple's previous $110 billion boost. This marks the largest increase in a stock repurchase program to date. Following this announcement, Nvidia's shares rose 0.8% in premarket trading, contributing to a more than 20% gain in stock value this year through Friday's close.

business.title: 20 IPOs to open for subscription this week: GMPs signal up to 38% returns
business.summary: Twenty IPOs are set to open for subscription between September 28 and September 30, featuring a mix of mainboard and SME issues with offer sizes from Rs 14 crore to over Rs 218 crore. Grey market premiums (GMPs) indicate potential returns, with Vans Electroengineerings at 38%, followed by SRIT India and EverestIMS Technologies at 24%. GMPs can fluctuate before listing.

technology.title: God of War Laufey Pre-Orders Starting Tomorrow, Editions Revealed
technology.summary: Sony has announced that pre-orders for God of War Laufey will begin tomorrow, September 29, at 10:00 am local time. The information was shared via PlayStation’s social media and blog, detailing various editions and pre-order rewards. Players can purchase different versions of the game, with additional incentives for those who pre-order ahead of the official release.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Case Renders Reveal New Camera Layout
technology.summary: Images of the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra's protective case suggest a redesigned rear camera module. The upcoming S Series may include four models, with the Galaxy S27 Ultra positioned as the premium option. Reports indicate that Samsung is considering modifications to the phone's back design, particularly focusing on the camera layout, as shared by a popular tipster on X.

technology.title: Google unveils new visual AI avatar with real-time features
technology.summary: Google has launched Gemini 3.8 Live, featuring a new visual AI avatar designed for enterprise users. This advanced chatbot includes real-time dialogue capabilities and improved reasoning. The Live Avatar can express emotions and supports asynchronous tool calling, enhancing user interaction. This update aims to provide a more engaging experience for businesses utilizing AI technology in their operations.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 LIVE India medal tally tracker, September 28: Esha wins silver; Pincky, Vithya win bronze
sports.summary: Indian shooter Esha Singh won silver in the women’s 25m pistol event at the Asian Games 2026, narrowly missing gold by one point. Additionally, Pincky Balhara secured a bronze medal in her kurash event. Vithya also contributed to India's medal tally with a bronze, marking a successful day for the Indian contingent at the ongoing games in Japan.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026: India to face Pakistan in hockey semifinals after thrashing Bangladesh
sports.summary: India concluded its group-stage campaign at the 2026 Asian Games men’s hockey tournament with a dominant 10-0 victory over Bangladesh. Harmanpreet Singh scored three goals, while Mandeep and Shilanand each added two. This win secured India five victories in five matches, allowing them to advance to the semifinals, where they will face Pakistan.

sports.title: Najmul Hossain Shanto ruled out of Asian Games with fever
sports.summary: Bangladesh batter Najmul Hossain Shanto has been ruled out of the Asian Games due to fever, as confirmed by the Bangladesh Olympic Association. The 28-year-old player will return home on September 29. His absence will impact the team's performance in the tournament. Further details regarding his health and recovery have not been disclosed by the association.

health.title: Worried about cancer growth after diagnosis? Raipur oncologist warns against 5 things that feed the disease
health.summary: Dr. Jayesh Sharma, an oncologist in Raipur, identifies five factors that may contribute to cancer growth and hinder recovery. He emphasizes the role of visceral fat, which creates a conducive environment for cancer cells. Sharma's insights highlight the importance of managing these factors to improve health outcomes for cancer patients and mitigate the disease's progression.

health.title: Vaping in childhood has bigger health risks than we’d thought
health.summary: Vaping among children poses greater health risks than previously understood, increasing the likelihood of mental health disorders and traditional smoking initiation. Electronic cigarettes, initially marketed as a smoking cessation aid, have raised concerns due to their potential negative impact on youth. Experts urge governments to take action to address these emerging health issues associated with e-cigarette use among young people.

health.title: Drug regulator warns against excessive use of painkillers and antibiotics, flags kidney risks
health.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) has cautioned against the excessive use of painkillers and antibiotics without medical guidance. It emphasized the importance of following medical advice to prevent adverse reactions and antibiotic resistance. The regulator highlighted potential kidney risks associated with indiscriminate use, urging individuals to use these medications responsibly and only as prescribed.

science.title: Link Rescue Spacecraft Burns Up After Failed Swift Rescue
science.summary: The Link rescue spacecraft, intended as the first American commercial robotic rescue vehicle in orbit, has burned up following technical failures during its mission to save NASA's Swift telescope. The spacecraft's attempt to perform a rescue ended unsuccessfully, leading to its destruction. This incident highlights the challenges faced in space missions involving advanced technology and commercial endeavors.

science.title: The Future of Computing Might Be Made of Bacteria
science.summary: MIT researchers have developed bacteria that act as transistors, enabling the creation of living "circuit boards" that can be printed on growth mediums in Petri dishes. This innovation mimics the function of transistors in electrical circuits, which serve as switches to control current flow. The advancement could pave the way for new computing technologies utilizing biological components.

science.title: New Wheat Gene Yr88 Explains 86% of Resistance to Stripe Rust
science.summary: Researchers at the University of Sydney have identified and mapped a new wheat gene, Yr88, which accounts for 86% of resistance to stripe rust, also known as yellow rust. This discovery aims to assist in developing durable breeding strategies for wheat. The findings were made at the Plant Breeding Institute in Cobbitty, New South Wales, Australia.

entertainment.title: Bigg Boss 20: Manoj Tiwari Reacts To Daughter Rhiti Tiwari's Clash With Qazi Touqeer
entertainment.summary: In Bigg Boss 20, a confrontation occurred between Rhiti Tiwari and Qazi Touqeer during a captaincy task that involved rap challenges. Host Salman Khan questioned Rhiti about her prior recognition before joining the show. The incident intensified the ongoing tensions among contestants, as they were split into teams to compete in the roasting task, highlighting the competitive atmosphere.

entertainment.title: Adnan Sami responds to Pakistani spy joke on 'India's Got Latent 2' with Ayushmann Khurrana as panellist: ‘Pehle mujhse permission lo’
entertainment.summary: In a recent episode of 'India's Got Latent', a joke involving singer Adnan Sami went viral. Comedian Kullu mentioned Sami while Ayushmann Khurrana discussed his film 'Udta Teer'. Sami responded to the joke, emphasizing the need for permission before making such references. The exchange highlights the intersection of comedy and celebrity culture in contemporary Indian entertainment.

entertainment.title: Huge Blow To Puri’s Reputation After Lady Producer's Allegations
entertainment.summary: Allegations made by a female producer have significantly impacted the reputation of filmmaker Puri Jagannadh. The film industry, often perceived as glamorous, is marred by financial disputes, particularly in distribution. These issues highlight the darker aspects of the business, revealing complexities and challenges faced by producers and distributors. The situation raises concerns about accountability and transparency within the industry.
